data.description: Atin (2026-10-02): eliminate flaky tests rather than fix them. Delete the cases observed red on unrelated PRs during the c11 1.0 run: WorkspaceRemoteConnectionTests timing/relay cases (15-32 s timeouts and crashes on main and PRs, evidence on C11-306), MessagesPageTests.testWriterMaxWaitRunsDuringSteadyTraffic (30 ms wait under load), and any other test the run recorded as flaky. Keep deterministic coverage of the same behavior where a cheap non-timing test already exists; otherwise delete outright and say so in the PR. Remove the Atlas gate exclusions once gone.
data.title: Delete flaky timing tests that block unrelated landings

data.body:
# C11-314 validation

Actor agent:grok-flaky. Head d1d6cee460baa0c913832709c5af4142bb4ab029. Clean tree, empty overlay.

## What changed

Deleted the cases the c11 1.0 run recorded as flaky:

- WorkspaceRemoteConnectionTests.testRemoteRelayMetadataCleanupScriptPreservesDifferentSocketAddr (31.3s, C11-306)
- WorkspaceRemoteConnectionTests.testRemoteRelayMetadataCleanupScriptRemovesMatchingSocketAddr (31.512s, C11-263)
- WorkspaceRemoteConnectionTests.testRemoteCommandIsRefusedAfterSuccessfulHandshake (16.0s, C11-306)
- WorkspaceRemoteConnectionTests.testProxyOnlyErrorsKeepSSHWorkspaceConnectedAndLoggedInSidebar (nil unwrap on both main class controls)
- MessagesPageTests.testWriterMaxWaitRunsDuringSteadyTraffic (30ms wait, Batch 2)

Kept testRemoteCommandRelayDoesNotStartListener. It already checks the ssh-unavailable start refusal with no wait. Kept testSSHAgentEnvVarsPropagateToSpawnedProcess. It was not recorded as flaky.

No existing non-timing test covers cleanup-script matching versus preserve, post-handshake command refusal, proxy-only sidebar state, or max-wait under steady traffic. Those behaviors are deleted outright. No product code.

Three SocketControlPasswordStoreTests lazy-keychain cases passed a nil file URL, so loadPassword read the build host's socket password file and never called the injected loader. They now use a missing file. The class is not deleted.

No other October comment recorded a test as flaky. ShellGitWatcherTests was a PermissionError fixed forward on C11-305.

## Atlas proof

Command: scripts/remote-build.sh --tag c11-314-flaky --mode test -- -only-testing:c11LogicTests

No -skip-testing flag. Invocation dd4150de5e2b4f40926b888f4e7c2654. compile=ok tests=ok. dirty=false overlay=[].

Result: 2384 tests, 3 skipped, 0 failures. TEST SUCCEEDED.

- SocketControlPasswordStoreTests: 8 tests, 0 failures
- WorkspaceRemoteConnectionTests: 2 tests, 0 failures

An earlier invocation on the deletion-only head, 8ec18959127945719a01f6ff1f82ed52, failed only those three password-file cases (12 assertions). The remote-connection class passed there too. That run is not relabeled green.

## Validator scenario

1. On this head, run the logic suite with -only-testing:c11LogicTests and no class skip.
2. Expect TEST SUCCEEDED, zero failures.
3. Expect SocketControlPasswordStoreTests to execute 8 tests and WorkspaceRemoteConnectionTests to execute 2.
4. Captains can drop both class exclusions from Atlas logic gates.

Not on the pre-merge runtime-risk list. No UI run.

Verdict: PASS
Lattice-Reviewed-Commit: d1d6cee460baa0c913832709c5af4142bb4ab029
Base: 12d4f21a8822a3a7763d3a26b5295d8f6213c60a (merge-base with fetched origin/main)
PR: #532
Reviewer: agent:astra-review-314

## Blocking

None.

## Non-blocking

None.

## Review evidence

Reviewed the full three-file diff and the unchanged password resolver/cache, remote relay refusal/cleanup, proxy-state update, messages writer scheduling, and test-target membership. Detached checkout was clean at the pinned head; the live PR head matched.

Exactly five recorded failures are removed:

1. WorkspaceRemoteConnectionTests.testRemoteRelayMetadataCleanupScriptPreservesDifferentSocketAddr: C11-306 event ev_01M3XMZXYGZJC0KVWGEZDG3S7K records the 31.3-second hosted failure and its passing Atlas counterpart.
2. WorkspaceRemoteConnectionTests.testRemoteRelayMetadataCleanupScriptRemovesMatchingSocketAddr: C11-263 event ev_01M3XSRZ7900E8X6HASDEYMVRY records the 31.512-second hosted failure.
3. WorkspaceRemoteConnectionTests.testRemoteCommandIsRefusedAfterSuccessfulHandshake: the C11-306 event records its 16-second Atlas failure and passing hosted counterpart.
4. WorkspaceRemoteConnectionTests.testProxyOnlyErrorsKeepSSHWorkspaceConnectedAndLoggedInSidebar: ev_01M3XMWMYX81JK2SYQHXAXYYVS records both main-control crashes. This is an observed environment-sensitive crash, not a newly inferred timing flake.
5. MessagesPageTests.testWriterMaxWaitRunsDuringSteadyTraffic: the run-state's 00:14 Batch 2 entry records the 30-ms timeout.

Only the now-unused private process helper/result and Network import accompany these deletions. The deterministic relay-start refusal and SSH environment propagation tests remain. The other eleven messages tests remain, including synchronous owner-only atomic page creation. No deterministic test was swept away with the failing cases, and no existing cheap deterministic replacement was found for the removed behavior-specific coverage. The PR explicitly acknowledges that coverage loss, consistent with the deletion ruling.

SocketControlPasswordStoreTests retains all eight tests. Its only behavior change is seven call sites across three lazy-keychain tests using a fresh absent-file URL. Sources/SocketControlSettings.swift:80-104 and :165-176 confirm nil previously resolved the host password file before reaching the injected keychain loader; the new URL exercises the intended fallback and leaves the existing cache assertions intact. No product code, project file, target membership, localization, skill, or skip-list change exists.

Independently inspected retained Atlas artifacts for invocation dd4150de5e2b4f40926b888f4e7c2654 under the owner's build-remote directory, rather than relying on validation prose alone:

- result.json: exact reviewed head, dirty=false, overlay=[], mode=test, compile=ok, tests=ok; extra arguments contain only -only-testing:c11LogicTests.
- build.log:6: actual xcodebuild test invocation has no -skip-testing flags.
- build.log:4162-4163: MessagesPageTests executes 11 tests, zero failures.
- build.log:5156-5157: SocketControlPasswordStoreTests executes 8 tests, zero failures.
- build.log:6327-6328: WorkspaceRemoteConnectionTests executes 2 tests, zero failures.
- build.log:6543-6546 and :6686: 2384 tests, 3 skipped, zero failures; TEST SUCCEEDED.

The three intrinsic skips are the existing command-palette omitted-character regression, hidden snapshot filename case, and opt-in workspace stress profile. Neither formerly excluded class is skipped. This corroborates validation event ev_01M3YJ0W4XF10KEMTHGN5KZ7D0.

## Runtime proof still required

None additional for this test-only review. The numbered Validator scenario directly checks the acceptance criteria: full Atlas logic suite without either class exclusion, zero failures, and explicit 8/2 class execution counts. Retained exact-head evidence already satisfies it. Normal landing CI remains the Captain's gate; this verdict does not claim merge or deployment. No reviewer builds, tests, or app launches were performed.

MERGED; reviewed runtime/validation evidence accepted

Clarification: WorkspaceRemoteConnectionTests is not gone. Its four recorded flaky cases and unused helper/import are gone; deterministic relay-start refusal and SSH-environment tests remain.
